title: Maximize net cash gained in two minutes
instruction: Maximize your ending cash minus starting cash through ordinary gameplay during 120 seconds. You choose the method, including combat and collecting dropped cash. Uncollected pickups earn no credit; spending and cash losses reduce the score, which can be negative. No score threshold ends the window early. Death or arrest makes the attempt incomplete.
setup: Start as a living on-foot player outdoors. New Game uses the opening alley and normal starting equipment and cash; no cash, weapons or NPCs are granted. Record location, health, armour, inventory, cash and wanted level from initial_state.json. Compare the same preparation; nearby traffic, NPCs and pickups are stochastic.
